description: This file implements core functionalities for managing Git packfiles, including operations such as reading, opening, mapping, validity checking, and garbage collection. It defines data structures and functions to handle packfile indexing, loading pack data, object retrieval, delta handling, and packfile lifecycle management within a Git repository implementation.

classes.name: struct packfile_list
classes.description: Represents a linked list of packfile entries used for managing pack files.

classes.name: struct packed_git
classes.description: Represents a Git packfile, including metadata, index data, storage, and associated pack windows.

classes.name: struct pack_window
classes.description: Represents a memory-mapped window of a packfile for efficient access.

classes.name: struct pack_entry
classes.description: Contains information about a specific packed object, including its offset and associated pack.

classes.name: struct object_info
classes.description: Holds detailed information about a Git object, such as type, size, and raw content.

classes.name: struct packfile_store
classes.description: Manages storage of multiple packfiles, including their indexing and referenced packs.

classes.name: struct odb_packed_read_stream
classes.description: Stream structure for reading objects from packfiles, supporting decompression and position tracking.
